IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM COS XII CENS PER P P ; IOVI VICTORI

Roman Sestertius Domitian, Rome, 86 AD, Reece Pd. 4, RIC 313. Obv: Laureate, draped bust right with the legend IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM COS XII CENS PER P P. Rev. Rev: Jupiter enthroned left holding victory and spear with legend IOVI VICTORI. SC in the lower part of the coin. Diameter 37mm; thickness 3mm; weight: 21.5g
